categories.label: Filing Formalities
categories.prompt: Assess Form 28 for this SLP (Civil): court and jurisdiction caption, party positions, the petition body, mandatory declarations, grounds, prayers, and any supporting affidavit this task names. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score other Form 28 points, other categories, or legal merit.

categories.label: Advocate's Check List
categories.prompt: Assess the Advocate's Check List and the Advocate-on-Record's certificate on this filing, including the signature block. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Listing Proforma
categories.prompt: Assess the Listing Proforma (Proforma for First Listing) that accompanies the filing. Decide only whether the columns or particulars named in this task are duly filled. Do not score other listing fields unless this task names them.

categories.label: Petition Presentation
categories.prompt: Assess the form of the petition: paper, spacing, font, margins, numbering, signatures and endorsements. Decide only the objection in the user message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Applications
categories.prompt: Assess interlocutory or miscellaneous applications named in this task (condonation, substitution, caveat, permission to appear). Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Annexures
categories.prompt: Assess the annexures: markings, true copies, order, and match to the Index or List of Dates. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Parties and Cause Title
categories.prompt: Assess the cause title, Memo of Parties, and party particulars named in this task. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Drafting and Execution Dates
categories.prompt: Assess the drafting date of the petition relative to filing, the supporting affidavit and the Vakalatnama. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Index and Paper Book
categories.prompt: Assess the common index, running pagination, and Part I / Part II (or volume) arrangement of the paper book. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Limitation
categories.prompt: Assess the Office Report on Limitation and any condonation of delay for a time-barred petition named in this task. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Affidavit
categories.prompt: Assess the supporting affidavit named in this task: presence, form, swearing, exhibits and blanks. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Translations
categories.prompt: Assess translations of vernacular documents, official translation or exemption, and translated powers of attorney. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Vakalatnama
categories.prompt: Assess the Vakalatnama: execution, acceptance, stamps, executant particulars and related endorsements. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Memo of Appearance
categories.prompt: Assess the Memo of Appearance named in this task. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: List of Dates
categories.prompt: Assess the List of Dates and Events named in this task. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

defects.defect: The Advocate-on-Record has not filed the requisite checklist in the prescribed format along with the petition or appeal.
defects.requirement: The Advocate-on-Record must file a checklist along with every petition. The checklist must be in accordance with the prescribed format.
where_to_look: Check the front of the case file, before the Cover Page and the Office Report on Limitation, for the Advocate's Checklist.
Check whether it is in the prescribed format, i.e. the numbered list of requirements each marked YES/NO/N.A., followed by the AOR's declaration.
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to auto-generate the Advocate's Check List in the prescribed format.
Option for the User to upload the Advocate's Check List with Jubeex.
Re-upload the petition along with the Advocate's Check List.

defects.defect: The petition, appeal or interlocutory application is not accompanied by a proper and duly sworn affidavit in support of the allegations of fact made therein.
defects.requirement: No petition, appeal or interlocutory application is to be registered unless it is accompanied by a proper and duly sworn affidavit in support of the allegations of fact made therein.
where_to_look: Check for an affidavit filed immediately after the main petition or application (after the Advocate-on-Record's certificate) in support of the allegations of fact made in it.
Check the attestation and the notarial seal at the end of the affidavit to confirm it is duly sworn.

If an affidavit is filed separately along with an interlocutory application that is not part of the main petition, check the cause title; it should identify that interlocutory application in the main case.
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to auto-generate the affidavit in support of the allegations of fact and prompt the User to have it duly sworn and upload the duly sworn affidavit with Jubeex.
Option for the User to upload the affidavit with Jubeex.
Re-upload the petition, appeal or interlocutory application along with the affidavit.
defects.location_source: F.No.57/Judl./2009 dated 3 August 2009, Page 5 of the PDF 2024042339.pdf

defects.defect: The petition is not duly signed by the Advocate-on-Record or party-in-person at the required places, including the Declaration, Advocate's Check List, Listing Proforma (Proforma for First Listing), main petition, Advocate's Certificate, application(s), Filing Memo, Memo of Parties, Vakalatnama, Memo of Appearance, and the last page of each annexure.
defects.requirement: The Advocate-on-Record is to sign each page digitally (Adobe Sign) at the required places, including the Declaration, Advocate's Check List, Listing Proforma (Proforma for First Listing), main petition, Advocate's Certificate, application(s), Filing Memo, Memo of Parties, Vakalatnama, Memo of Appearance, and the last page of each annexure.
where_to_look: Check the Declaration, Advocate's Check List and Listing Proforma (Proforma for First Listing) for the Advocate-on-Record's digital signature at the prescribed place(s).
Check each page of the main petition for the Advocate-on-Record's digital signature at the required place(s).
Check the Advocate's Certificate, application(s), Filing Memo, Memo of Parties, Vakalatnama and Memo of Appearance for the required Advocate-on-Record digital signature.
Check the last page of each annexure for the Advocate-on-Record's digital signature.
Verify that the signatures are digitally affixed through Adobe Sign and appear at the prescribed signature locations.
how_to_cure: Option for the User to allow Jubeex to auto-fill a saved signature at the relevant places as specified, after User approval.
Option for the User to re-upload the petition.

defects.overlap_note: Narrower than D058. D058 covers whether a Memo of Parties was filed (or cause-title particulars stand in its place). This check is only whether the cause title matches the impugned judgment's parties. Do not re-decide the parent.
defects.defect: The cause title does not correspond to the impugned judgment and the names of the parties therein.
defects.requirement: The cause title must correspond to the impugned judgment and the names of the parties therein.
where_to_look: Check the cause title on the first page of the main petition.
Compare the names, order and description of the parties in the main petition with the cause title of the impugned judgment, usually placed after the Synopsis and List of Dates.
While comparing, check for spelling variations, omitted or dropped respondents, and parties described as “through LRs”.
Also verify the status of the parties, as the roles of petitioner and respondent may change depending on which party has challenged the impugned judgment.
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to compare the cause title with the impugned judgment, identify any discrepancies in the names of the parties, and, upon confirmation by the User, update the cause title accordingly.
If the cause title is not disclosing all the details, ask the User to upload the Memo of Parties of the impugned case, then allow an option to edit or auto-edit.
Option for the User to review and edit the cause title with Jubeex.
